points.description: States that the test compares the observed (sample/empirical) frequencies or data, using the term "observed".
States the other quantity as the assumed/estimated (fitted theoretical) probability density function (PDF), giving both the term "assumed" or "estimated" and "PDF" (distribution).
points.partial_credit: 0.5 if only "assumed/estimated" or only "PDF/distribution" is given, not both terms

rubric.notes: Full marks only if the student gives "observed" and "assumed/estimated PDF" with the correct terms. Give 0.5 on P2 only if one of its two terms (assumed/estimated, or PDF) is stated precisely. Vague answers such as "actual and theoretical values" without PDF, or wrong items such as "mean and variance", earn nothing for that point.
